title: Interrupted System Call
subtitle: deep-range relay break / treaty burst
recovered_source: Interstellar relay transcript / partial burst capture
collapse_vector: Negotiation cut short by planetary panic

overview.summary: A transmission log documenting a rescue negotiation repeatedly interrupted by Earth's own command instability until the corridor closed.
overview.thesis: Humanity failed to speak for itself long enough to remain rescuable.
overview.viewer_hint: Use the timeline page for pacing; the dossier reads like panic only after you see how many interruptions were institutional.
overview.content_warning: panic, failed rescue, mass casualty implication

sections.title: Synopsis
sections.body: The relay offered a narrow but credible rescue corridor. Each interruption looked temporary in isolation: a new cabinet, a defense override, an emergency board, a media backlash. Together they made continuity impossible.
sections.emphasis: no one could hold the line

sections.title: Negotiation dynamics
sections.body: Different factions used interruption tactically, hoping to bargain from a stronger position once control stabilized. The archive stresses that control never stabilized. Bargaining strategy became a self-consuming proof that no authority could commit the planet to a single promise.

sections.title: Recovered excerpt
sections.body: The relay burst ends mid-offer nine separate times. Successive governments, emergency boards, and military councils each interrupted the exchange long enough to prove no one on Earth could speak for Earth for longer than a minute.

sections.title: Interpretation
sections.body: Unlike 0x07E2BIG, this record never reaches a mature exchange phase. Its lesson is shorter and more humiliating: a species can lose help before it decides whether it wants to deserve it.

events.label: Corridor offer
events.body: A deep-range relay proposes evacuation and infrastructure support under strict coordination rules.

events.label: Command interruption
events.body: A new emergency authority halts negotiation pending review and credentials.

events.label: Factional override
events.body: Military and corporate blocs reopen contact only to request privileged continuity access.

events.label: Corridor closure
events.body: The rescue window closes after repeated proof that Earth cannot sustain a single binding voice.
